nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rainy cyberpunk city intersection in the first reference image, featuring towering skyscrapers, a giant flickering holographic billboard with a blue-purple female silhouette, neon purple and orange signage, wet reflective asphalt, drifting fog, and distant car light trails.
<Subject 2> is the dark-cloak female hunter in the second reference image, an East Asian woman with long wet black hair, a black tight leather combat bodysuit, a tattered floor-length black cloak, black gloves, and a reverse-grip silver short blade, with a cold assassin-like demeanor.
<Subject 3> is the fox-mask tech female hunter in the third reference image, an East Asian woman with short black hair, a white fox mask with red inner ears and brown whisker markings, a black leather trench coat embedded with glowing cyan neon circuit lines, a waist-mounted glowing data device, black thigh-high boots, and a blue energy dagger crackling with electric arcs.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 10-second cinematic action sequence in which <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> duel in <Subject 1>, a rainy neon cyberpunk intersection. The sequence opens with a tense standoff, escalates into fast close-quarters blade combat, builds to a slow-motion energy surge, and culminates in a powerful mid-air blade clash. All three reference subjects guide character identity, wardrobe, and environment throughout the sequence.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the rainy intersection, holographic billboard, neon lighting, wet pavement, fog, and skyscraper skyline are retained across all shots.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the long black hair, black leather bodysuit, tattered cloak, silver short blade, and cold assassin demeanor are retained in every shot.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the short black hair, white fox mask, cyan-neon trench coat, blue energy dagger, and cybernetic aesthetic are retained in every shot.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic ultra-realistic style with 8K detail, Blade Runner 2049 color grading, volumetric light, anamorphic lens flare, shallow depth of field, and high dynamic range. Heavy rain and wet surfaces create constant specular highlights.
[Shot 1] The camera begins on a rain-soaked puddle reflecting two silhouettes and neon signs; a raindrop shatters the reflection. The camera tilts up slowly to a wide establishing shot of <Subject 1>, the rainy cyberpunk intersection. <Subject 2>, the long-haired dark-cloak hunter, crouches low in a predatory stance five meters from <Subject 3>, the fox-mask tech hunter who stands upright with her blue energy dagger pointed forward. The giant holographic billboard behind them flickers with scan-line glitches. A distant thunder flash briefly illuminates the entire street. Rain falls in visible streaks, and fog drifts across the wet road.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a fast tracking shot as <Subject 2> explodes forward, kicking up a massive water splash, her black cloak unfurling like dark wings. She closes the distance and slashes her silver blade upward diagonally, carving through the rain. <Subject 3> sidesteps sharply and brings her energy dagger up to block. The blades collide in a blinding blue-white electric burst, the shockwave sending ring-shaped mist and droplets outward. The camera rapidly orbits 360 degrees around the clash at chest height, motion blur streaking the weapons and rain.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to handheld close-quarters coverage. <Subject 2> unleashes a rapid triple thrust with the silver blade, three precise lethal streaks cutting through the rain. <Subject 3> parries each blow, every impact generating blue electric arcs; the neon circuits on her trench coat flicker on contact. <Subject 3> delivers a sharp side kick to <Subject 2>'s ribs; <Subject 2> blocks with her forearm and slides half a step back on the wet ground, leaving water trails. <Subject 2> spins under her cloak and launches a roundhouse kick; <Subject 3> leans back to dodge. The camera shakes subtly, and raindrops hit the lens creating soft blur.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a low Dutch angle in slow motion. <Subject 3> slams her energy dagger into the ground; a cyan shockwave ripples across the cracked pavement, blasting <Subject 2> airborne. <Subject 2> twists mid-air, cloak fully spread, rain droplets suspended around her, long hair flowing upward as she raises the silver blade overhead. <Subject 3> pulls the dagger free, its blue glow doubling in length, and looks up at her airborne opponent, rain streaming down the white fox mask. Purple and cyan rim light outlines both figures against the towering skyscrapers.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts and rapidly pulls back. <Subject 2> dives down from the air with full body weight, blade overhead, cloak cascading like a black waterfall. <Subject 3> grips the energy dagger with both hands and raises it to meet the strike. The blades collide mid-air in an enormous blue-white energy explosion, a shockwave expanding outward, rain vaporizing into steam, puddles erupting into a circular water wall. The camera pulls all the way back to a full wide shot of the intersection; the explosion glows like a newborn star, building windows hum, and the holographic billboard suffers severe static distortion. The final frame freezes on the moment of impact, both warriors locked blade-to-blade, rain suspended, neon refracting through droplets.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy relentless rainfall continues throughout, with individual splashes on wet asphalt and leather. Distant low-frequency thunder rumbles under the opening. Metallic blade-clash impacts carry a sharp high-frequency ring followed by electric crackling and zapping from the energy dagger. Water splashes and footstep impacts deliver heavy low-end thuds. Cloak and fabric whoosh during spins and dashes. Faint distant city ambience includes traffic hum, neon sign electrical buzz, and echoing drips. The final energy explosion delivers a deep bass boom with high-pitched electric discharge and rushing steam.

non_diegetic_music:
An intense cinematic orchestral score with dark synth undertones. Slow-building atmospheric drones and low sustained strings open the standoff, then aggressive taiko-style percussion and industrial synth stabs drive the combat. The slow-motion power surge shifts to a soaring tense string crescendo, and the final clash hits with a massive orchestral impact followed by decaying reverb and near-silence. Tempo accelerates from 80 BPM to 140 BPM across the sequence.
